Notes.Text:
This update for gh fixes the following issues:

  * Allow installation tokens to attach files

- Packaging improvements:
  * pinned golang.org/x/net version is now 0.60.0 fixing excessive
    CPU consumption on repeated HTTP/2 initial window changes
    (CVE-2026-78669, bsc#1285291).
  * Add BuildRequires: timezone required by TestTokenRefresherRefresh
  * Reduce use of non-default GOFLAGS to simplify conditionals
    necessary to build on all targets e.g. ppc64le cannot use PIE.
  * Build PIE with pattern that may become recommended procedure:
    %%ifnarch ppc64le GOFLAGS="-buildmode=pie" %%endif go build
    A go toolchain buildmode default config would be preferable
    but none exist at this time.
  * Drop mod=vendor, go1.14+ will detect vendor dir and auto-enable
  * Remove go build arg -trimpath. Since this is a packaged binary,
    build environment paths do not leak private information. Other
    build scenarios such as minimal container builds could have a
    use for -trimpath. Absent a clear need, use go build defaults.
  * Remove ldflags arg linkmode=external. Absent a clear need, use
    go build defaults.
  * Remove go build arg -modcacherw. Newly-created directories in
    the module cache should be left read-only instead of making
    them read-write. It is not normally not necessary to manually
    edit the module cache in an OBS build. Absent a clear need, use
    go build defaults.
  * Remove go build ... which searches subdirectories. For control
    in packaging build specific paths where wanted func main() is
    defined. Typical paths are source root e.g. go build, or
    subdirectory of cmd e.g. go build ./cmd/%{name}.
  * Skip TestBrowseModelProvidesVisualHierarchyInWideLayout fails
    on openSUSE_Tumbleweed i586 armv7l with issue matching TUI
    decoration character.
  * Disable go test on ppc64le due to multiple failures on Leap
    15.7 ppc64le with nil pointer dereference. Failing tests
    include but are not limited to Test_GhEditor_Prompt_skip
    Test_GhEditor_Prompt_editorAppend
    Test_GhEditor_Prompt_editorTruncate
  * Syntax to skip multiple tests is hard to find in documentation:
    go test -skip "TestA|TestB"
    Where the skip list is a regex using shell quotes as needed.

- Update to version 2.102.1:

Vulnerabilities.Description: A malicious HTTP/2 peer can cause excessive CPU consumption in the client or server by opening a large number of streams and then sending many small SETTINGS frames containing SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE values.
